description: Adaptive compensation parameters for SO-101 Robot 4 (auto-calibrated)
_z_offset_comment: Per-robot pick/place z offset (meters, signed). Added to BOTH execute_pick_object and execute_place_object commanded z. Positive = raise (descend less), negative = descend further. 2026-06-12: initialized 0.0 (neutral) — observe pick/place residual before tuning (robot0:-0.01, robot2:+0.03 reference).
_pick_xy_offset_comment: Pick-only radial xy offset (meters, signed). Pushes pick xy outward along base→object direction. Positive = further from base. Applied at execute_pick_object AND pull_object (shared helper). 2026-06-12: initialized 0.01 (robot0 recently-tuned value). URDF gripper geometry identical to robot0/2 so this is a safe starting point — measure trajectory undershoot on robot4 and refine.
_pick_offset_comment: Per-robot pick depth from object top (meters). pick_z = object_height - pick_offset + z_offset + sag_offset. Larger = grip higher on object. 2026-06-12: initialized 0.02 (robot0 value). Refine if pick is too shallow/deep.

gravity_sag._comment: Disabled — robot2 params not valid for robot4. Recalibrate before enabling.
